sentences.text: The bank’s MSE business loan sanction letters say pre-payment charges are 2% of the amount prepaid.

For a UCB’s loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01, the current RBI directions say a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on business-purpose loans to MSEs with a sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh.
Because the sanction date was not provided, I cannot confirm whether this specific sanction letter falls under that in-force direction.

missing.searched: Searched the evidence for the date of the specific MSE sanction letter; only the applicability condition that the RBI direction covers loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01 was found.
